activity_summary: Alone, you kept the same refusal. The man who enjoys the mercy is Burbage's. The farewell stays uncast. You did not add a second way of saying no.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in The rest, and no name

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not name him tonight.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
